I farm sorghum on this small plot near my home, only 0.18 hectares, but I have other land too where I keep my main crops. For this sorghum I use the seed I saved from last year because it grows well here and I cannot afford the improved seed from the cooperative — and the fertilizer they bring is often late and costs too much for such a small plot. I will put some manure from my oxen on it before planting, and my wife and children will help me weed with the hand hoe. The rains come once here so I depend on them, no irrigation is possible.
